primitives.name: Test Runner Worktree Isolation
primitives.verbatim_quote: Enforce Test Runner Worktree Isolation: - Ensure tracked root `vitest.config.ts` excludes `**/.worktrees/**`, `**/.agents/**`, `**/data/snapshots/**`, `**/node_modules/**`, `**/dist/**`, `**/.next/**`, `apps/mobile/**`.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'W': 'Worktree path set', 'E': 'Exclusion pattern set', 'F': 'File system path'}
primitives.assumptions: All paths are absolute and filesystem-accessible.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When E ⊈ W, test runner leaks into unauthorized worktrees.

layer2.mapping: The exclusion set E defines a kernel constraint on W such that F ∩ W ⊆ ¬E, ensuring test isolation.
layer2.telemetry: Number of excluded paths matched during test execution.

primitives.name: CI Compilation Error Fix
primitives.verbatim_quote: Fix 4 Blocking CI / Compilation Errors on Main: - `packages/ingestion-pipeline/src/process-sport.ts`: Fix syntax error at lines 1753-1754 by replacing `lineSnapshotsPersisted?: number; lineArchiveErrors?: number;` with `lineSnapshotsPersisted, lineArchiveErrors,`.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'S': 'Source code segment', 'E': 'Syntax error indicator', 'R': 'Repaired code fragment'}
primitives.assumptions: Error is syntactic and can be resolved by replacement.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When E ≠ ∅, CI pipeline halts due to unresolvable syntax.

layer2.mapping: Syntax error E is resolved by applying transformation R to S, yielding compliant code.

primitives.name: Node Module Junction Repair
primitives.verbatim_quote: Repair Corrupted Node Modules Junctions: - Run `node scripts/hybrid-node-modules.cjs C:\Users\Garrett\Sports C:\Users\Garrett\Sports` to repair `@sports/*` junctions.
primitives.assumptions: Junctions are symbolic links managed by hybrid-node-modules.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When J ⊈ M, module resolution fails.

layer2.mapping: R repairs J by re-establishing symbolic links between M and J.
layer2.telemetry: Module resolution success count after repair.
